title: Aromatic Stone Spanish Eggs Omelette
description: A silky, aromatic one-pot Spanish omelette cooked on a hot stone plate, featuring free-range eggs, smoked paprika, and fresh vegetables for a rich, comforting breakfast.

ingredients.name: free-range eggs
ingredients.notes: egg white and yolk mixed together

instructions: Preheat a flat stone plate over medium heat for 5 minutes until hot.
Whisk 4 free-range eggs with 1/2 cup diced bell pepper, 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms, 1/2 cup chopped spinach, and 1/2 cup diced tomatoes until well combined.
Stir in 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, 1/4 teaspoon sea salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.
Drizzle 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil onto the heated stone plate and swirl to coat the surface.
Pour the egg mixture onto the stone plate, spreading it evenly with a spatula.
Cook uncovered for 6 minutes until the edges begin to set and the bottom shows a golden crust.
Gently flip the omelette with a large spatula and cook for an additional 4 minutes until fully set and golden.
Slide the omelette onto a cutting board, slice into wedges, and serve immediately.
